brief: Two-storey brown-brick corner commercial building with light limestone trim: a corner section of 1895 with a canted corner entrance and decorative brick and stone work at the parapet, and an 1897 northern addition topped by a metal balustrade with urn-shaped balusters lettered 'CABOT 1897'. Both sections keep their original storefronts; a general store below, offices above, on a quiet main street of a small farm town.

floors: W W W W W W W W W
facade.notes: the Cabot Building (Heron Lake MN, 1895): a long two-storey brick corner block with a decorative parapet and corner pediment, stone sills; a prairie town's main street of one- and two-storey fronts trailing away; a grain elevator glimpsed beyond

why.note: the biggest block on the main corner of a railroad town
